description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_ConfigSchema_Builder_ConfigSchema, which builds a runtime configuration schema object from an interchange format for the HTMLPurifier library.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_ConfigSchema_Builder_ConfigSchema
classes.description: A builder class that converts configuration interchange data into a runtime schema object used for configuration validation in HTMLPurifier.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs and returns a HTMLPurifier_ConfigSchema object by processing the provided interchange data, registering namespaces, directives, aliases, and value aliases.
